result.quote: I wholly dedicate the silver to the LORD for my son’s benefit, to make a graven image and a molten idol.
result.reason: The key is supported, since she dedicates the silver to make an idol. However, “For what” is ambiguous: the same verse also says she dedicates it “to the LORD” and “for my son’s benefit.” The question should specify that it asks what the silver will be used to make.
